主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. filed a Current Report on Form 8-K on May 12, 2014, to disclose that its Board of Directors held a special meeting on May 9, 2014, to review the status of its proposed transaction with Prospect Capital Corporation. The Company had entered into an agreement to sell its common shares to Prospect, but the transaction will not be completed by June 12, 2014, due to SEC regulatory concerns. Prospect stated that the SEC staff has delayed the effectiveness of its registration statement on Form N-14. Prospect intends to appeal the decision to the SEC's Chief Accountant and possibly the Commission. The Board will monitor the appeal and consider alternatives, including terminating the agreement. The Company plans to finalize its business combination by June 12, 2014, provided certain conditions are met, including approval by securityholders under the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia) and the Company’s Articles. If approved, an information circular will be sent to securityholders ahead of a special meeting to approve the Arrangement Agreement. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Prospect (PSEC).
